articles.title: How Dolly Parton told her life story through six iconic songs
articles.description: A legendary singer-songwriter, her music covered themes around love, loss, female empowerment and spirituality.

articles.title: Household energy bills to hit three-year high as Ofgem announces 4% rise from October
articles.description: A household using a typical amount of gas and electricity will pay £60 a year more, regulator Ofgem said.

articles.title: NHS failing child sex abuse victims in adulthood, say psychiatrists
articles.description: There have been decades of mistreatment and mismanagement of those who seek help later in life, say experts in a new, damning report.

articles.title: Dad of woman who took her own life says Treasury failed in its duty of care
articles.description: Chloe Moffat died last year, after she was told of allegations she had shared sensitive confidential information about colleagues, which she denied.
